description: This file is a shell script for configuring and managing GRE tunnels and associated network settings for a hotspot device. It includes variable definitions, functions for creating tunnels, retrieving parameters, initializing system events, and updating iptables rules.

methods.name: init_snooper_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes system events related to snooper functionality by enabling circuit and remote snooping.

methods.name: read_init_params
methods.description: Retrieves GRE tunnel parameters from the PSM database.

methods.name: create_tunnel
methods.description: Creates GRE tunnels, configures bridge interfaces, and manages network interface setup for tunneling.

methods.name: init_keepalive_sysevents
methods.description: Initializes keep-alive related system events and sets parameters for hotspot keep-alive functionality.

methods.name: update_bridge_config
methods.description: Updates iptables rules for network forwarding and filtering.
